correctness.rationale: PASS. Polynomial convolution gives identically 27X(t)^2+343Z(t)^2=250Y(t)^2; quartic difference positive for t>=2 ensures increasing positive AP. Independently computed resultant of quadratics X,Y is 90724673403000=2^3*3^3*5^3*7^6*13^4, hence any common factor of first two AP terms is among 2,3,5,7,13; t congruent 1 mod 2730 agrees at each with coprime t=1 case, so pairwise gcd=1 because A+C=2B and oddness. CRT residues t=5 mod 11², t=0 mod17², t=3 mod19² impose exact exponent 2 in squared polynomial terms alongside fixed cube exponents 3 at 3,5,7; therefore each term is powerful but no perfect power, for infinitely many distinct t. Independently factored all integers <=57967 using SPF: exactly 186 Achilles numbers; exhaustive ordered pair / third-term membership check yields only primitive (14283,36125,57967), establishing sharp least largest term. The finite certificate proves only bounded minimality; the polynomial/CRT argument separately proves infinitude.
